title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3 blind SSRF was possible via remote references in JSON Schema validation…
description: A blind Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability exists in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA versions before 2026.3. This vulnerability arises from the handling of remote references in JSON Schema validation, potentially allowing an attacker to induce the application to make unintended network requests without direct visibility of the response.
